reason: Paying ₹99 for just 100 grams to pack everyday office parathas is way too steep when a standard sauce bottle costs less, and ordering online is too much friction.
objection: ₹99 for 100g feels steep when a 200g pouch of Mother's Recipe is ₹70 and 500g Maggi is ₹72
would_change_my_mind: If it is stocked on Blinkit for under ₹60 or launched in a larger 300g value pack.
